basis: Final production-deployed checkpoint and frozen production-lock evidence

defect.description: The immutable production-lock record predates deployment and does not itself carry a later deployment-authorization event. Final deployed-state evidence proves deployment occurred, but the checkpoint does not contain a dedicated immutable record linking that later deployment action to an explicit owner deployment authorization event.

repair_policy.required_closure: Add a separate owner-authorized deployment provenance/ratification record if and only if explicit owner authorization is available; do not rewrite historical evidence.

verdict: PARTIAL PASS — PRODUCTION CONTENT VALID; DEPLOYMENT AUTHORIZATION PROVENANCE GAP OPEN
